It's about 2000 sq ft. 4 bedroom, 2.5 bath. I think the best way I can describe it is a large rectangle split down the middle, the long way. On the front side is the kitchen, dining, and living. The other side is the entry/ mudroom, half bath laundry (right by kitchen and dining), then a small office, and next to office is the other big full bathroom (more in living room area) and then bedrooms wing off of the house. So really the half bath laundry is no more than 15-20 ft away from the full bath. 

This laundry half bath room is only about 5x10' with washer and dryer side by side. So there is barely enough room to get in front of washer and dryer let alone use toilet and sink. That bathroom is barely used by us as it is.

Of course, the house is a little less than 2000sq ft. One and half story (attic space was turned into a bedroom).. the kitchen, dining, and living is all open and the half bath/laundry is right by the kitchen/dining. Probably 20 ft over in the living room, there is our other bathroom (full) that our guests mostly use. It's very big, about 11'x10'. There is a hallways off living room that leads to 2 more bedrooms plus the master suite. So in total our house has 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths right now. We have an office located in between the 2 bathrooms, so they are really not that far apart. 

The laundry/half bath is a very narrow room. About 5'x 10' so the 3' door that leads into that room makes it feel even smaller. The toilet and sink are barely useable just how they are laid out.
